description: Preregistered micro-local routing benchmark for the Aristotle mixed-regime corpus. Whole-corpus composition in 0.8 must decompose into locally distinct windows, preserve operator boundaries, allow abstention, and reject a higher-level collapse that would erase localization.

windows.label: Primary-substance priority window
windows.rationale: The preregistered micro-profile is one-way priority/dependence; local variation must not be imported merely because it occurs elsewhere in the same corpus.

windows.label: Relatives/reference-to-another window
windows.rationale: The preregistered micro-profile marks a distinct local regime; the substance-priority operator must not colonize the relatives window.

windows.label: Source-bounded two-regime reconstruction window
windows.rationale: This reconstruction explicitly compares both regimes, so composition is warranted here without implying that composition belongs to each source passage.

windows.label: Global relation-first challenge window
windows.rationale: A project-level universalization claim plus rival objections is not itself a source-born local operator profile; the ecology must abstain rather than choose the least-bad operator.
